title: CloudDrop
description: Pair desktop and mobile devices with a QR code to access files stored on your own system.
sections: Moving between desktop and mobile should not require uploading every file to a separate storage service.
The Flutter desktop app starts a Go HTTP server and a Cloudflare tunnel. The mobile app scans the QR code to access the selected directory through the server API.
QR pairing reduces manual URL entry. Files stay on the host system; network access depends on the server and, for remote access, the tunnel.
File serving, upload/download metadata, mobile access, desktop server startup, and QR generation.
In progress. No public release or usage metric is claimed.
